backbone: official NCNC jointly trained from scratch
checkpoint: fixed final5, evaluate validation once after final5
promotion: B3 mean paired MRR strictly above BOTH B1 and B2 on each of Cora and PubMed; no added wins/CE threshold
preserve_lead: positive mean paired MRR over both single branches on either dataset; preserve secondary CE signals separately
test: sealed; only x/train/valid_pos/valid_neg decompressed from canonical archive
negative_sampler: unchanged official PyG negative_sampling; no validation or test label filter; identical per-seed schedules
auxiliary_mask: frozen single-target removal for training positives; training-only raw stars for validation
R: frozen constructor, right-continuous train-active ECDF, Linear6-8 ReLU mean/max log1p(T/S) zero Linear18-1;75 parameters
G_adapter: one zero-padded six-dimensional token; same75param encoder/head; repeated mean=max, zero count slots
matched_capacity: all arms except pure B0 have two identical75param branch templates;150 added params
duplicate_controls: D_RR two frozen R branches; D_GG two GRAPH branches; independent paired slot initializations
shuffle: fixed candidate derangements within exact per-seed scheduled occurrence-multiplicity strata; R whole multiset+T+S moves together; G whole vector moves together; no labels
decision: SUPPORTED needs screening lead on both datasets, independent+inner positive mean and strict-majority paired MRR gains over both singles, both duplicates and each effective R/G shuffle; NO_SIGNAL screen => UNSUPPORTED; otherwise UNRESOLVED
numeric_backend: deterministic algorithms=True, fixed CUBLAS workspace, TF32 off; validated before screening; architecture/optimizer unchanged
